=== /en/calendar page (event calendar core feature) ===
HTTP 200, size 55739
<title>Calendar | OpenCulturas</title>
=== leaflet/map assets in calendar or any page? ===
/en/calendar map-refs: Leaflet leaflet 
/en/locations map-refs: 
/en/events map-refs:

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== /en/calendar page (event calendar core feature) ==="; curl -s -o /tmp/cal.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}, size %{size_download}\n" "http://openculturas.ddev.site/en/calendar"; grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/cal.html; echo "=== leaflet/map assets in calendar or any page? ==="; for p in calendar locations events; do c=$(curl -s "http://openculturas.ddev.site/en/$p" | grep -oiE "leaflet|leafletjs|osm-tile|tiles/" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '); echo "/en/$p map-refs: $c"; done
